title: Lanework attachment
description: An attachment's `index.md` under an `attachments/<uuid>/`, beside its `blob.<extension>`.

created.description: When the attachment was materialized, and by whom.

modified.description: The last write to this attachment's metadata — a rename touches this file and no other.

title.description: The original filename's stem, extensionless: surfaces recompose `<title>.<extension>`. Not unique — the uuid is the identity.

extension.description: The blob's extension, bare and with no leading dot. A promise: a reader constructs `blob.<extension>` without listing the directory, and a mismatch is reported broken.
